scripts.postbuild: pagefind --site .next/server/app --output-path out/_pagefind && cp out/404/index.html out/404.html && next-sitemap
scripts.capture:guides: UV_CACHE_DIR=local/uv-cache uv run --no-project --with-requirements scripts/guides/requirements.lock python scripts/guides/cli.py capture
scripts.narrate:guides: UV_CACHE_DIR=local/uv-cache uv run --no-project --with-requirements scripts/guides/requirements.lock python scripts/guides/cli.py narrate
scripts.render:guides: UV_CACHE_DIR=local/uv-cache uv run --no-project --with-requirements scripts/guides/requirements.lock python scripts/guides/cli.py render
scripts.check:guides: UV_CACHE_DIR=local/uv-cache uv run --no-project --with-requirements scripts/guides/requirements.lock python scripts/guides/cli.py check
scripts.test:guides: UV_CACHE_DIR=local/uv-cache uv run --no-project --with-requirements scripts/guides/requirements.lock python -m unittest discover -s scripts/guides/tests -v
scripts.test:guides:browser: UV_CACHE_DIR=local/uv-cache uv run --no-project --with-requirements scripts/guides/requirements.lock python scripts/guides/browser_fixtures.py && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=local/playwright playwright test tests/guides
